{{Short description|Former country in Japan}}
[[File:Wajinden diagram.svg|thumb|Map illustrating the path from the [[Daifang Commandery|Daifeng commandery]] to [[Yamatai]], and its distances in the [[Wajinden]].]]
{{nihongo|'''Toumakoku'''|投馬国|Toumakoku/Tsumakoku}} is one of the countries said to have existed in the [[Japanese archipelago]] in the [[3rd century]].<ref name="nihonrekishicom-2023a">{{Cite web |title=投馬国(toumakoku) - 邪馬台国 |url=https://nihon-rekishi.com/yamataikoku/toumakoku.html |access-date=2023-03-14 |website=nihon-rekishi.com}}</ref>

It is listed in the [[Wajinden]]<ref name="第2版世界大百科事典内言及-2022a">{{Cite web |last=第2版,世界大百科事典内言及 |first=百科事典マイペディア,日本大百科全書(ニッポニカ),ブリタニカ国際大百科事典 小項目事典,世界大百科事典 |title=投馬国とは |url=https://kotobank.jp/word/%E6%8A%95%E9%A6%AC%E5%9B%BD-104202 |access-date=2022-06-21 |website=コトバンク |language=ja}}</ref><ref name="れーし-2021a">{{Cite web |last=れーし |date=2021-02-15 |title=投馬国は謎の強国 |url=https://rekishi-shizitsu.jp/tsumakoku/ |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=ゆっくり歴史解説者のブログ |language=ja}}</ref> and the ruling official is called a {{Ill|Mimi and Mi|lt=Mimi|ja|ミミおよびミ|simple}}<ref name="第2版世界大百科事典内言及-2022a" /><ref name="nihonrekishicom-2023a" />

According to "[[Records of Three Kingdoms]]," Toumakoku was located 20 days by water to the south from Fumi (in [[Umi, Fukuoka|Umi]], [[Kasuya District, Fukuoka|Kasuya District]]) or Sueranokuni ([[Karatsu, Saga|Karatsu City]], [[Saga Prefecture]]).<ref name="nihonrekishicom-2023a" />

Hata District (central-western part of the Korean Peninsula)).

It may have been the leading power of the [[Wakoku]].<ref name="れーし-2021a" />
